📊 5 Live Dashboards ⚡ Telegram Automation Built In-House
Where We Started

Real Problems, at Scale

🧾
No Digital Proof at Point of Sale

Field and spot sales happened without any digital invoice or authenticity record — customers had no formal proof of the discounts or transactions they received.

📦
Stock Visibility Across 340+ SKUs

Mismatches between records and field reality. The FF and corporate teams struggled to quickly verify stock levels, pack sizes, or pricing when visiting distributors or customers.

📉
Unclear Product Velocity & Regional Demand

With 340+ products, it was genuinely difficult to know which SKUs were fast-moving, slow-moving, or nearing stockout — especially when broken down by zone.

🔄
Distributor & Performance Gaps

No structured way to track distributor health, spot declining primary/secondary trends, follow up on overdue tasks, or push real-time performance feedback to the sales team.

The Response

Six Solutions. Built In-House.

Each project started from a real pain point and was built without depending on an external MIS team — and is in active daily use.

Solution 01

EDULINK POS

Customers needed authenticated proof of purchase and clear discount records. We built a mobile-ready POS in-house — no MIS dependency.

  • Secure User ID & password login per staff member
  • Barcode scan → instant product & pricing lookup
  • On-the-spot invoice generation at point of sale
  • Print-ready PDF invoice handed to the customer

Solution 02

Stock Intelligence

A single source of truth for all 340+ SKUs — stock levels, pack structures, and pricing — accessible by any team member anywhere.

  • Live stock quantity per SKU across locations
  • Full pack structure and pricing detail per product
  • Filter by Brand (Deli / iSelect) and Category
  • Export to Excel or PDF — for orders and pricing reviews
↗ aci-edulink.github.io/stock-intelligence
340+ SKUs Excel & PDF Export
Solution 03

Product Velocity

Understand demand patterns across 340+ products — by category, zone, and urgency — before stockouts happen.

  • Fast-moving vs slow-moving SKU classification
  • Zone & area-wise sales breakdown
  • At Risk flags for SKUs nearing zero stock
  • Category-level velocity graph: sales, velocity, demand
↗ aci-edulink.github.io/product-velocity
⚡ Fast-Moving ⚠ At Risk 🐢 Slow-Moving
Solution 04

Distributor Performance

A complete view of every distributor's health — primary and secondary sales trends — so declining partners are actioned before it's too late.

  • Primary & secondary sales trend per distributor
  • Declining trend detection & automatic flagging
  • Action planning & follow-through for underperformers
  • Review tracking and performance history log
>
Solution 05

P&L Financial View

A unified financial overview that keeps leadership in control of cost, revenue, and gross profit — without waiting for month-end reports.

  • Cost control and expenditure monitoring
  • Cumulative sales trend — monthly and year-to-date
  • Gross Profit (GP) trend tracking
  • Month-on-month performance comparison
>

Chaining — Sequential Pipeline

Links multiple components together — user input → prompt template → LLM → data processing script — so each step feeds the next automatically, no manual handoff.

🔎
Retrievers (RAG)

Lets the LLM search private, company-specific data — sales records, SKU databases, distributor lists — that wasn't in the model's training, grounding outputs in real operational context.
